notes.title: Transparent Framework Patch
notes.content:
Large code patch today, that should have no impact on gameplay (other than slightly better load times when reloading levels).

The patch today was to improve a bunch of areas of my shared framework, which is used between games. There were things that were added in this game that will be useful for future games and current prototyping, so I wanted to make these improvements official in the framework.

If you run into any issues let me know! But hopefully it's smooth all around.

notes.title: Sheep for the Stars Update 1.1
notes.content: [p]Sheep for the Stars has been out for almost a month now, so it's time for a 1.1 version with all the accumulated bug fixes and adjustments from feedback. Some of the stuff listed has been deployed in previous minor patches, but I'm consolidating all of the updates and details into this one post along with some other changes that went into this current version today.[/p][p]As always, thanks everyone for all the feedback you've left through Steam Reviews, Discord, Reddit and even YouTube Shorts. That's right, I watch your shorts and look for feedback in there too! If you have any more feedback or thoughts and praises, feel free to continue sending them through all those channels![/p][p][/p][h1]Balance and Playability[/h1][p]If you tried the game early on in the launch, these changes might be for you! Since the initial release there have been a few tweaks made to the balance and difficulty of the overall single player experience.[/p][p]Some S-Ranks near the middle of the campaign (World 3 was definitely a target) have had their time buffers increased a little. Nothing more than 1 or 2 seconds on any single level, but a few of the times required near perfect routing so this has been relaxed a little. We'll leave the perfect routing to the speed runners and Challenge Mode enjoyers.[/p][p]Additionally, here's a quick list of some other things that changed in this category:[/p][list][*][p]Fuel pickups have a larger collision radius that more accurately reflects the object size[/p][/*][*][p]Spike collision area reduced a little to make "near misses" more exciting[/p][/*][*][p]Hit-stop on fuel pickups (single player only) has been tweaked to avoid flow-state impact[/p][/*][*][p]Reset button re-enabled for levels you haven't beaten yet[/p][/*][*][p]Reset button changed to a hold (for half a second) to reset the current level[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Multiplayer[/h1][p]Did you know this game has multiplayer? Well it does, and it's a blast. It takes all the rage of trying to complete challenge mode or S-Ranking harder levels, with the added chaos of PvP racing and player collisions. Joy![/p][p]What didn't bring joy however, was a whole slew of random Steam Lobby integration bugs / performance tanking party balls / and more. Here's the list of some stuff that changed affecting multiplayer:[/p][list][*][p]Configurable score limit in the lobby settings[/p][/*][*][p]Celebration screen added once score limit is achieved[/p][/*][*][p]Level time limit configuration options added to help when you pick a level too hard for the group[/p][/*][*][p]Catchup mode enabled by default on lobbies because it makes the game feel better for everyone[/p][/*][*][p]Catchup mode improved to affect anyone who is behind the leader by 5 points of more (down from 7)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed duplicate lobby in browse list bug[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Quit / re-Host issue so you no longer need to restart the game[/p][/*][*][p]Added support to directly join from friends list when sitting at the main menu (may improve further later)[/p][/*][*][p]Significantly improved turn around times for re-hosting lobbies[/p][/*][*][p]Lobbies can change between Friends / Open with players currently connected[/p][/*][*][p]Better synchronization between clients with wildly different pings[/p][/*][*][p]Spectator camera enabled if you finish the level before your friends (ping sensitive, but working on better ideas)[/p][/*][*][p]More stuff I forgot or didn't write down[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Customization[/h1][p]The game has a totally and completely optional cosmetic DLC that also helps fund improvements to this game and future games, awesome! It now has more than 10 "fancy" sheep shaders, a custom rocket, and the prestige of being honestly way too generous. You should not get it and flaunt your cosmetics in the multiplayer lobbies.[/p][p]But that's not all! Here are some things that actually changed or were fixed in the sheep cosmetics department (customize screen), and these are in the base game and not locked behind some fancy DLC:[/p][list][*][p]Feedback requests granted: Added pink and several greyscale options for base sheep colors[/p][/*][*][p]Improved controls in the customization widget to support clicking, mouse wheel, keyboard, gamepad, touchscreen[/p][/*][*][p]Improved a bit of the look around the visualization of the customize menu[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues with cosmetics not showing in multiplayer sometimes[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed celebration screen to now correctly show all player cosmetics... yes including the Cow skin[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue with saving player color if you love spam clicking[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Huge thanks again to everyone who's reached out. I love this game and really enjoy seeing others laughing and having a great time listening to sheep bleats as they roll down huge hills. Keep the feedback coming. I want to hear about what you love, what has made you cry, what has made you cry but in a good way, what you hate, what you want to see the most. Maybe your best times in Challenge Mode? Leave your thoughts anywhere and everywhere.[/p][p]See you in the next one![/p]

notes.title: Fixing Steam Lobbies
notes.content:
Hey everyone, there have been a few bugs related to Steam Lobbies that are finally fixed in the latest patch.  Here's a summary of issues:
- Quitting a multiplayer game and rehosting results in ghost lobbies that can't start games
- Quitting a multiplayer game can cause clients to be unable to join the host again without a restart
- Disconnecting during a match can also relate in the above issues
- Slower connections would sometimes end up in an issue where they can't ever see any lobbies in the list
- Additionally, the same connections also had a problem hosting games after a game can end

The above issues have all been fixed (yay!).  But there are probably some new ones, please let me know if you run into any more and either leave a comment here or reach out on the Discord Server to figure out a reproduction case so I can get it tackled quickly.

Workarounds you can use if you have issues playing multiplayer:
- Hosting always seems to work, so any client that joined a game can restart their client and will be able to play again without issues
- If you have trouble seeing lobbies or joining them, you can use the steam overlay to join a friend's lobby directly.  Just run the game, and when you're at the title screen / main menu, open the overlay (shift + tab) and right click -> Join game for a friend who is playing.  This will put you right into the lobby and bypass the search.

Hope it's all working great now!  Happy sheeping!

notes.title: Sheep for the Stars is Out Now!
notes.content: [p]Welcome everyone![/p][p][/p][p]Sheep for the Stars is now fully live! Yes it did release a couple weeks ago, but I decided to hold off on that update to include all the changes in here.[/p][p]First of all, thanks to everyone who's been playing the game so far! There have been a lot of playtesters jumping back in to play multiplayer, quite a few content creators hopping in and having a blast (eg: [dynamiclink href="https://youtube.com/shorts/PJBLvYrgv5c"][/dynamiclink] ), and lots of great feedback and bug reports across all channels. The support so far has been great, keep it coming![/p][p][/p][h1]Updates[/h1][p]The game launched with the time-trial campaign mode and as a quick last minute addition, the challenge mode with three selectable difficulties. Once you've completed the base levels in the initial campaign, you can attempt runs through the entire set to your personal best times with the cumulative time tracking. The hardest challenge mode also ends your run when you fall in the water, which has proven to be quite the rage inducer. Make sure you practice before diving into that one.[/p][p]Multiplayer support has been expanded to include full score tracking, catchup mode, more lobby options, much better synchronization, and more. I think the game is fun in all modes, but multiplayer definitely has that additional something else... lets call it spice.[/p][p][/p][h1]Future[/h1][p]Looking for feedback on what you'd like to see in the game. Let me know what you think, what you like, what you need, the possibilities are endless. I try to read and respond to all feedback and incorporate it into the roadmap for all games I make and this one is no exception. Leave a Steam Review, join the Discord Server, comment in the Subreddit, or just should from the mountains. I appreciate all and any feedback you have.[/p][p]Current Short List of potential additions:[/p][list][*][p]Secret / Challenge level sets, unlocked on 100% base completion (currently achievement tracked)[/p][/*][*][p]Multiplayer modes: Capture the flag, collect / break targets, sheep-sket-ball, tag, hot potato, 'wolf mode'[/p][/*][*][p]Gallery, more replay integration, additional powerups, multiplayer replay?[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]DLC[/h1][p]All planned multiplayer and completion updates will be included in the base game and will not be DLC. It is my philosophy that game modes and multiplayer options should always be included in the base game, so those will continue to be provided without DLC. Similarly, rewards for completing the game or mastering it's challenges should also be included in the base game. Therefore any challenge level sets will also be included.[/p][p]DLC packs will be reserved to significant additions or alterations to the game (brand new ways to play, large content drops, etc).[/p][p]Additionally, there is now a Supporter Pack DLC as well. This pack is entirely cosmetic, and is intended for fans of the game to have an option to help support future expansion. There's no gameplay impact (other than looking cool while fumbling with friends), and is entirely optional. I don't plan on making any additional cosmetic DLCs, and will add any new things of this nature directly to the same pack.[/p][p]Huge thanks to everyone who's picked that up so far. It really helps me dedicate more time to expansion in the game, and it's been fun randomly seeing the skins show up in multiplayer games or on live streams I pop into.[/p][p][/p][h1]Speedrunning[/h1][p]This game is sort of built for speedrunning. The single player game is intended for level exploration and practice, with the challenge mode being built directly to support speedrunning and complete game and controls mastery. As such, the thing I'd love to see the most is for this game to show up in a category on speedrun.com or something.  Seriously if you're into speedrunning, help me build some exposure over there. I think it could be a fun candidate for a whacky unknown game. Share your best times with me, post videos and I'll help boost exposure![/p][p][/p][h1]Special Thanks[/h1][p]I'm humbly grateful for everyone who has picked up the game so far, provided feedback (on any channel, and all channels: Reviews, Discord, YouTube commentary, Reddit). It's been amazing. This game was just a crazy sill idea / fever dream I had, so I built something I had fun playing and had fun speedrunning. Amazing to see others have had fun doing the same. Warms the heart.[/p]

notes.title: Balance Updates
notes.content:
Made a second post for this one to call it out directly. A few of the S-Rank times were just a little too optimized, so I've relaxed the times a little on some specific early levels, and added a bit more buffer to the last two worlds.

Don't worry, the challenge still remains, these times were only adjusted by 1 second in most cases and 2 seconds on a few of the longer levels. You'll still need a very well optimized route to get there on time, it's just marginally easier.

notes.title: Another Really Quick Update
notes.content:
Another quick update today to try to adjust a couple things, this time mostly cosmetic.

Visual:
- Foreground outlines on platforms and characters are a bit more bold, making the visuals a little more striking and more intentionally stylized
- Skyboard / full background layer has a paper texture applied to it, again to add some stylization and separation from the foreground elements

Gameplay:
- Increased camera field of view slightly, includes about 5% to 10% around the edges of the screen in visibility
- This should help finding better approaches to levels, and make the falling boulders just a tiny tiny bit less frustrating and easier to path around

Let me know if you have any feedback or other small changes QoL changes.  Thanks everyone for playing and your reviews so far!

notes.title: Minor Bug Fix Patch
notes.content:
We had a great multiplayer stream on Twitch with the RandomKarl crew, and found a few interesting bugs to fix.  Here's a quick update regarding the things that were caught and fixed.

Multiplayer
- Fixed issue with lobby configuration not synchronizing correctly for higher latencies
- Fixed issue with sheep potentially spawning off map
- Fixed issue when spawning off map that causes level to end prematurely
- Fixed issue with supporter pack skins not working during multiplayer celebration screen

General
- Fixed issue with camera tracking when synchronizing level load.  Camera will now track players as they spawn, instead of zooming in and out very quickly when synchronization finishes
- Reduced time to hold reset button when retrying levels (single player modes only)

Thanks everyone for all the feedback so far!

notes.title: Enabling Restart Button on All Levels
notes.content:
Just a quick update today regarding the "Press to restart" functionality in the game.

Previously you needed to complete a level before the ability to restart a level was enabled. This is now enabled on all levels, making it a bit easier to set your initial clear times without having to navigate back and restart the level.

Additionally changed the restart button to be a "hold to restart" button instead of an instant press. This will avoid any restarts by accident ruining that perfect run.

Happy sheeping everyone! Thanks for all the feedback so far.

notes.title: Releasing on August 7th!
notes.content: [p]It's been a while, welcome everyone![/p][p]For the last little while I've been heads down working away at the launch version of Sheep for the Stars! Recently, I announced that the launch day is August 7th.[/p][p]There have been so many changes recently that I'm excited to share with everyone on launch. Here's a summary of some of the big changes.[/p][p][/p][h1]Challenge Mode[/h1][p]Some of the feedback I received on the game previous was a mix of "this is too easy for a rage platformer" and "the high level of difficulty ruins the experience". I figured the best way to try to accommodate as many players as possible was to increase the options to play the way you want.  This is a strategy I'll continue to use on future games as well.[/p][p]To make the game a bit easier for newcomers, I tweaked the difficulty selector. The easy difficulty level now provides 2 additional fuel and a more lenient ambient fuel charge while falling. This will help new players make progress through most of the game's levels.[/p][p]Hard mode includes the rising water level, but the stakes still aren't high enough for the more dedicated precision platformer players.[/p][p]Thus, Challenge Mode was born. Once you complete all the levels in the base game, the main menu changes. The original play button changes to a 'Time Attack' button, so players can still try to achieve the best time per level. Additionally, a new button for Challenge Mode is added to the menu.[/p][p]This mode is a very punishing one-shot mode through all the levels sequentially. Contact with the water from a long fall results in an end to your attempt. This amps the challenge of the game to the max. Players who practice each sequence in Time Attack will have an upper hand here.[/p][p]The mode also tracks your total game time, so once you're able to finish a whole run, you can also try to beat your time. For those into speedrunning, this mode is for you.[/p][p][/p][h1]Adding Juice[/h1][p]A lot of time is dedicated to polishing the gameplay feel, and overall juice in the game. Menu and controls responsiveness has been improved, more effects added, more feedback and reactive effects are being added every day. [/p][p]Many things in isolation being added are very subtle but in aggregate really help bring the experience together.[/p][p]Additional visual effects, level variation / decoration systems, better particles, environment improvements, and so much more. [/p][p][/p][p]Thanks everyone for following me on this journey so far, hope to see you all on August 7th. If you're interested in helping get the word out, that's great! Jump into any of the social channels (discord or reddit), or get in contact through email to chat more![/p]

notes.title: Demo Update Post Next Fest
notes.content: [p]Thanks everyone for checking out the game during Next Fest! I received some great feedback, personal reviews, and play reports. It was great seeing all the reactions to the game.[/p][p]I've been pretty busy the last couple of weeks, but it's time to start the journey to release.  Currently hoping to have the full version of this game out in July, but will have an update when I have a better idea of what that looks like.[/p][p][/p][h1]Demo Update Details[/h1][p]I made a couple very small QoL updates to the gameplay. Nothing super noticeable, but the player controller is a bit tighter in responsiveness now. Additionally, collisions have been optimized a bit better to have more player friendly interactions with near misses.[/p][p]I've also made some changes to the UI. The old button style (settings menu, multiplayer options) have been updated to fit the general stylization of the game a bit better. This is also in preparation for being able to apply the style to some other games coming soon. So follow my developer page (or join the email list) if you want news on those.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again everyone for all the support so far. See you at release! Unless you want to get involved in some multiplayer playtesting. Then reach out to me on any of the social channels to let me know and I'll see if I can get you into one of the playtest groups.[/p]

notes.title: Next Fest Update and Fixes
notes.content: [p]Thanks to all the new players so far in Next Fest. This is the first time I've had a game in Next Fest and so far it's been great! I've had a chance to chat with some of you so far, and looking forward to seeing how things go going into the weekend.[/p][p][/p][p]I wanted to take some time to do a quick update to the demo now that some more players have come through and checked it out.[/p][p][/p][p][b]DIFFICULTY CHANGES[/b][/p][p]So far I'm keeping the changes to the game difficulty to a minimum, but always looking for feedback from all players. Whether you're a precision platformer pro or new to this game, maybe the cozy graphics pulled you in.  I'd love to hear from anyone that has feedback for the game! Discord, Reddit or Steam Communities are all great places to get in touch.[/p][p]That being said there are two small tweaks in this build to help with some difficulty or potentially more edge cases that can feel a bit unfair outside of the design of the game.[/p][p]Here's an outline of the changes made in this area:[/p][list][*][p]Level 1-5 - Moved the early chokepoint platforms ever so slightly apart for a bit more maneuverability[/p][/*][*][p]Level 1-5 - Lowed the first set of fuel pickups closer to the platform making the launch a bit easier to hit, the fall from higher up in the level is already punishing enough for such an early level[/p][/*][*][p]Fuel Pickups - Increased the hitbox size on the fuel pickups so it covers the whole model, this will reduce the chances of the game considering it a near miss when the player has actually passed through the pickup and should be awarded a refuel[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]VISUAL UPDATES[/b][/p][p]Some small visual tweaks have been made to clean up the visuals a tiny bit for readability, cleaner interactions, and some nice to haves I had lying around.[/p][p]Updates Included:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue with lighting that was reducing a bit of the character highlighting, now it's easier to see sheep on the move (especially in multiplayer)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue with leaf bursts when passing by trees, they now animate correctly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed smoke rings from jetpacks to be more ring shaped, which leads to a more pleasing animation and a bit cleaner effect on the playfield[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with shadows on distant objects sometimes flickering depending on aspect ratio[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]UNDOCUMENTED FEATURE[/b][/p][p]A (beta, use at your own risk!) undocumented feature has been enabled in gameplay just to test out if you're interested.[/p][p]Gamepad Only (for now while testing) - In single player levels, after you've completed a level and are sitting at the recap / summary screen if you hold "right bumper" and press "left bumper" while continuing to hold the right bumper you will see a replay of your previous attempt.[/p][p]You can't currently do anything with the replay but I may use this for ghost saving / sharing, replay sharing, or some other feature as I play around with it (potentially post release).[/p][p][/p][p][b]THANKS[/b][/p][p]I want to take a moment to thank you all again for checking out the game and providing all the feedback so far. After Next Fest I'll probably be focusing really heavily on all the new levels, features and polish in the final game to get ready for release.[/p][p]Drop by any of the social channels to come say hello, if you're interested in some behind the scenes stuff on this game and the others, I've started a series on YouTube as well.[/p]

notes.title: What is Sheep for the Stars?
notes.content:
Hey everyone, lots of great feedback so far.  Good to hear from people trying out the early access / prototype demo, and excited to keep hearing from you all!

Today I want to just chat a bit about what the game is, some ideas behind it and what the future might hold for it. Of course, there's still a lot of time for this game to evolve before some of the "no turning back" details are locked in!

[b]What is "Sheep for the Stars"?
[/b]This game is a precision platformer (or rage-bait platformer), designed around the classic "vertical climb" recipe. Master the systems and movement in the game, climb through levels (against gravity) where small mistakes could result in a fall back to the beginning of the level / zone.

Though this genre is heavily inspired by games like Jump King, Sheep for the Stars has a larger focus on the racing aspect of the game.  Master each section to compete for better time scores, use tokens granted by those scores to unlock new customizations and other goodies. Additionally, you can also challenge 2 to 7 other players in a free-for-all race in private and public Steam lobbies. In fact, the current early access demo has full multiplayer support to check out and provide feedback on right now!

[b]Why a platformer?
[/b]They all say "don't make a platformer" or "saturated market", and this is of course very likely correct. Sheep for the Stars is a passion project, a design I've had for a while that I really just want to see out in the wild for players to enjoy. I do really think the gameplay loop and mechanics are quite fun, and the end-state vision for the game definitely has a lot of meat to it.

[b]The Future
[/b]I was planning on targeting a May 2025 release date, but unfortunately some delays have made that schedule a bit too tight.  The good news, it's now in Steam Next Fest in June, so now there's a tangible target for a lot of the additional improvements I want to make to the demo.

If you want to help out, wishlists and demo plays are the best way to check out the game and stay informed of any upcoming changes and progress. 

You can also provide feedback anywhere you want like:
- The Discord Server
- Community Hub posts and comments
- acehigharcade.com
- Or just any random DM place you find

Thanks everyone for following along so far, also released a big visual update to the demo today.  More improvements coming very soon.

notes.title: Demo Playtest Live!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We're trying something new with Sheep for the Stars.  We're doing sort of an "early access" demo, launching it early to get some multiplayer and game-feel feedback directly from you!

Working alongside players and fans, our goal with this "extended playtest in the form of a demo" is to get some really early feedback on the essential core of the game when it's still in a stage to overhaul many parts of this core.  We'll also be updating the demo frequently, with more polish and features while collecting this feedback so expect many updates!  Can't promise a frequency but once a week is probably a good estimate.

Thanks everyone for playing the private playtest up until now, and looking forward to more players enjoying the game in this next public playtest phase!  As also, hop in the discord server and drop any feedback you have.  There's also a direct link to discord in the demo itself

Basic controls:
- Gamepad:  Directional aim with left stick, A (or bottom face button to launch), X (left face button to brake)
- Mouse / Keyboard: Aim with mouse, left click to launch, right click to brake

Have fun!
